body_markdown:
Compliance training shouldn’t take dozens of hours a year to manage.


Watch Streamline Compliance Training, a recent recorded live webinar from Affinity, and see how modern compliance teams are reducing the administrative burden of training while improving audit readiness, visibility, and the employee experience.


We’ll show how Affinity helps Compliance, Risk, Legal, HR, and L&D teams:


• Save tens of hours every year by automating assignments, reminders, recurring training, and reporting


• Stay audit-ready with centralized records, real-time completion data, and reporting available when you need it


• Reduce compliance risk by making sure the right people receive the right training at the right time


• Eliminate spreadsheets and manual follow-up across onboarding, annual training, and role-based programs


• Give employees and managers time back, with a simpler training experience and fewer unnecessary administrative steps


• Scale your program without scaling the workload as your organization, requirements, and training catalog grow


We’ll also demonstrate Cora, Affinity’s AI suite, which takes streamlining even further — helping teams create and maintain training, work through compliance questions, and handle time-consuming program tasks faster.


The result is more than an automated LMS: it’s a compliance training program that is easier to operate, easier to prove, and easier for your organization to complete.


Whether you’re a CCO, CRO, CLO, HR leader, or L&D professional, this session will give you practical ideas for reducing the time your team spends administering training while building a stronger, more defensible program.


Register to see how much time your compliance training program could give back to your team.
